title: PCR Reaction Optimization
author: Kenneth Schackart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ygqftvw
materials: Spray entire work area with RNAway.
Allow reagents to thaw on ice
Vortex mix all reagents for approximately 00:00:05 .
Hit PROCEED to select a reaction cycle.
Spin down all reagents for approximately 00:00:05 .

steps.title: Prepare Work Area
steps.instruction: Decontaminate the workspace and equipment to prevent contamination.

substeps.instruction: Spray the entire work area, including pipettes, tip holder for PCR tubes, and work surface, with 70% EtOH.
Wipe the area with a paper towel.

steps.title: Prepare Cooling Station
steps.instruction: Set up an ice bath to keep reagents cold.

substeps.instruction: Fill a styrofoam container halfway with ice (located at Marley 527, across from Marley 509).
Place the PCR tube holder on the ice and allow it to cool for 00:03:00.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Move necessary reagents from storage to the cooling station.

substeps.instruction: Transfer Master Mix, primers, RNAse free water, and target tubes from the freezer to the PCR tube holder on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Reaction Vessels
steps.instruction: Label and handle PCR tubes carefully to avoid contamination.

substeps.instruction: Label one tube as 'NTC' and the other as 'TARG'.
Touch only the outside of the tubes and avoid touching the inside of the caps.

steps.title: Assemble Reaction Mixture
steps.instruction: Add reagents to the reaction vessels, optimizing primer concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Add the required components to both tubes, starting with 1.0 μL (0.5 μM) of primer.

steps.title: Mix and Centrifuge
steps.instruction: Ensure the reaction mixture is homogeneous and collected at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Run Thermocycler Program
steps.instruction: Load the samples and initiate the PCR program.

substeps.instruction: Place the reaction vessels into the thermocycler.
Use the ' ' keys to scroll to the 'EPCR' program.
